channel.title: GeoPulse. Geopolitics in brief
channel.description: Signal-first briefings on geopolitics, edited by Lavkesh Dwivedi.

item.title: Oil prices drop and stock markets rise after reports of deal to end Iran war
item.description: Oil prices dropped and stock markets rose after reports of a potential deal to end the Iran war, raising hopes of an agreement between the US and Iran. This development comes after days of escalation, with markets reacting positively to the possibility of reduced tensions.

item.title: Tehran Appears to Cast Doubt on a Deal as Trump Makes New Threats
item.description: Tehran cast doubt on a deal with the US as President Trump made new threats, adding uncertainty to the negotiations. The developments raised concerns about the prospects of an agreement, with Iran's stance and Trump's comments affecting the situation.

item.title: How China could shape the direction of the US-Iran war
item.description: Analysts suggest China could play a role in shaping the US-Iran conflict, citing shared interests in reopening the Strait of Hormuz. This could create a path towards peace, as both the US and China have a vested interest in the stability of the region.

item.title: Trump threatens Iran with ‘higher level’ bombing if it doesn't reopen Strait of Hormuz
item.description: Iran has expressed interest in a "comprehensive agreement" with the US. The Strait of Hormuz has been virtually shut since February 28, blocking about 20% of world oil supplies. The strait has ‌been virtually shut since the conflict began on February 28 with air attacks on Iran ‌by ⁠the U. S.

item.title: How close is the United Kingdom to breaking up?
item.description: The UK's unity is being questioned ahead of the May 7 elections, which could see nationalist gains in Scotland and Wales. Sinn Fein already leads in Northern Ireland, adding to concerns about the potential risks to the UK's unity.

item.title: US cancels visas for board of Costa Rica newspaper critical of Trump ally
item.description: The US cancelled tourist visas for board members of Costa Rica's leading newspaper, La Nación, which has been critical of President Rodrigo Chaves, an ally of Donald Trump. La Nación called the move an "indirect attack on press freedom," criticizing the US's actions.

item.title: Prestianni could miss Argentina games as FIFA extends ban to World Cup
item.description: Gianluca Prestianni's FIFA ban has been extended to the World Cup, potentially keeping him out of Argentina's first two group games if he is selected for the squad. Gianluca Prestianni could miss Argentina's first two group games if he is selected in their World Cup squad.

item.title: Jason Dresen readies for the Peace Corps and, hopefully, the Foreign Service
item.description: Jason Dresen is preparing to join the Peace Corps and potentially pursue a career in the Foreign Service after graduating from VCU in 2026. Class of 2026: Jason Dresen readies for the Peace Corps and, hopefully, the Foreign Service VCU News.

item.title: What happened to Trump’s ‘Project Freedom’?
item.description: Donald Trump announced 'Project Freedom' to escort stranded ships through the strait, but the operation was paused without explanation. Donald Trump announced ‘Project Freedom’, an operation to escort stranded ships through the strait.

item.title: Venice Biennale in crisis: The controversies explained
item.description: The Venice Biennale jury resigned over disputes about Russia's and Israel's participation, resulting in the Golden Lion award being withheld this year. Following the resignation of the jury over Russia's and Israel's disputed participation, the traditional Golden Lion will not be awarded this year.

item.title: Iran says Strait of Hormuz passage to be ensured after US pauses operation
item.description: Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps says it will ensure safe passage through the Strait of Hormuz with new procedures in place after the US paused its operation. Navy of Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) says safe transit will be ensured with new procedures in place.

item.title: What is the FDD, the pro-Israel think tank shaping Trump’s Iran policy?
item.description: The Foundation for Defense of Democracies (FDD), a pro-Israel think tank, has influenced Trump's Iran policy with its talking points. The FDD's stance on US-Israel cooperation against Iran has been adopted by the Trump administration.

item.title: Iran says ships can pass Strait of Hormuz as Trump warns of bombings without a deal
item.description: Iran's Revolutionary Guard announced that ships can pass through the Strait of Hormuz under unspecified procedures. This came after President Trump paused a US military effort to escort vessels through the strait.

item.title: 'If They Don't Agree, Bombing Starts': Trump Threatens Iran Amid Deal Buzz
item.description: President Trump threatened Iran, stating that bombing would start if they don't agree to a deal. The threat comes amid ongoing diplomatic efforts and rising tensions between the US and Iran.

item.title: Russia snubs Ukraine's unilateral ceasefire, firing dozens of drones
item.description: Russia launched drone strikes on Ukraine, killing 27 civilians, despite Ukraine's unilateral ceasefire. The attack disregards ongoing peace efforts and escalates the conflict between Russia and Ukraine. Russia disregards Ukraine’s ceasefire, launching drone strikes that kill 27 civilians amid ongoing conflict and failed peace efforts.

item.title: Russia ignores Ukraine's unilateral ceasefire and attacks kindergarten
item.description: Russia attacked a kindergarten in Ukraine, prompting the Ukrainian president to state that Russia has "spurned the ceasefire". Kyiv is now deciding on further action to take in response to the Russian aggression.

item.title: Crocodile spotted in waters off Sentosa, water activities at beaches halted
item.description: A crocodile was spotted in waters off Sentosa, prompting a halt to water activities at beaches. This is the second reported sighting this year, following one in late January. Authorities have taken measures to ensure public safety.

item.title: German police raid neo-Nazi criminal youth groups
item.description: German police raided locations in 12 states, mainly in the East and South, targeting neo-Nazi criminal youth groups. Prosecutors described the operation as a targeted raid. The searches aimed to disrupt the groups' activities.

item.title: Democrats gain midterm edge, NPR poll shows. And, U.S. pauses 'Project Freedom'
item.description: Democrats have gained an edge over Republicans in voter enthusiasm for the midterm elections, according to an NPR poll. Meanwhile, Trump announced that "Project Freedom" is paused due to progress toward an Iran agreement.

item.title: Hantavirus strain capable of human transmission found in 2 cruise ship passengers, officials say
item.description: Two cruise ship passengers were found to have the Andes virus, a strain of hantavirus capable of human transmission. The World Health Organization says this virus is primarily found in Argentina and Chile.
